description: This file defines the 'InProcessTestCluster' class which manages an in-memory testing environment for Orleans silos and clients, including starting, stopping, restarting silos, initializing clients, configuration, and logging functionalities.

classes.name: InProcessTestCluster
classes.description: Manages in-memory silo and client lifecycle for Orleans testing, providing methods to start, stop, restart silos, initialize clients, handle configurations, and logging.

methods.name: DeployAsync
methods.description: Deploys the cluster, initializes silos and optionally initializes the client.

methods.name: StartAdditionalSilo
methods.description: Starts an additional silo, joining the existing cluster.

methods.name: StartSilosAsync
methods.description: Starts multiple silos asynchronously.

methods.name: StopSilosAsync
methods.description: Stops all running silos.

methods.name: StopClusterClientAsync
methods.description: Stops the in-memory cluster client asynchronously.

methods.name: StopAllSilos
methods.description: Stops all silos synchronously.

methods.name: StopAllSilosAsync
methods.description: Stops all silos and cleans up resources asynchronously.

methods.name: StopSiloAsync
methods.description: Stops a specific silo asynchronously.

methods.name: KillSiloAsync
methods.description: Simulates crash by killing a specific silo asynchronously.

methods.name: KillClientAsync
methods.description: Stops the client connection abruptly.

methods.name: RestartSiloAsync
methods.description: Restarts a specified silo asynchronously.

methods.name: CreateSiloAsync
methods.description: Creates and starts a new silo with specific options.

methods.name: GetLog
methods.description: Returns the accumulated log as a string.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Cleans up resources asynchronously.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources synchronously.

methods.name: InitializeClientAsync
methods.description: Initializes the cluster client asynchronously.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Performs initial startup of silos and optionally initializes the client.

methods.name: GetActiveSilos
methods.description: Returns an enumeration of currently active silos.

methods.name: GetSiloForAddress
methods.description: Finds and returns the silo handle for a given silo address.

methods.name: WaitForLivenessToStabilizeAsync
methods.description: Delays until the cluster's liveness has stabilized after changes.

methods.name: GetLivenessStabilizationTime
methods.description: Calculates the timeout duration to wait for cluster liveness stabilization based on options and recent activity.
